title: BPM System 2026｜从视频素材到实时演出控制系统
titleEn: BPM System 2026 — From Video Clips to Realtime Performance Control
summary: 基于 REACTOR Opening 的实地经验，研究 DJ 波形、BPM 与相位、Resolume 视频层、Cue 与人工触发如何构成可现场演奏的实时视听系统；区分已验证的操作方法与进一步研究。
summaryEn: A practice-based report from REACTOR Opening on DJ waveforms, BPM and phase, Resolume visual layers, cueing and human control as a performable live audiovisual system.
